9443a3b66b4fdbbd.description: About Entaj Since 2004, Entaj has established itself as a prominent poultry producer in Saudi Arabia. The company currently boasts an annual capacity exceeding 90 million birds, with strategic plans to expand this to 185 million by 2026. Entaj is dedicated to ensuring food security and sustainability, consistently delivering high-quality poultry products through the application of world-class, environmentally friendly technologies. The Role of Rendering Supervisor Entaj is seeking a Rendering Supervisor to manage and oversee all daily operations within the Rendering Plant. This full-time position is based in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The primary objective of this role is to ensure the efficient processing of poultry by-products, maintain optimal cooking parameters, guarantee consistent protein meal quality, achieve high production yields, and ensure strict compliance with food safety, environmental, and HSE requirements. Key Responsibilities Supervise the daily operation of all rendering production lines, including intestine, feather, and blood processing lines, ensuring the proper function of hydrolyzers and associated equipment. Monitor and control cooking parameters such as temperature, pressure, residence time, and moisture content, adhering to approved operating procedures. Calculate and optimize batch formulations and cooking ratios to ensure consistent product quality and maximize protein yield. Ensure the quality of finished protein meal and rendered fat meets established specifications. Monitor production Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including production yield, throughput, energy consumption, and raw material utilization. Coordinate with the Maintenance Team to minimize equipment downtime and ensure the implementation of preventive maintenance schedules. Ensure proper handling of raw materials and finished products to minimize losses, contamination, and waste. Monitor process deviations, troubleshoot operational problems, and implement corrective actions. Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, hygiene standards, and company Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) procedures. Supervise operators, allocate duties, provide on-the-job training, and ensure adherence to standard operating procedures. Prepare daily production reports and analyze operational performance to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in a rendering plant or similar industrial environment. Demonstrated ability to supervise daily operations and manage production lines effectively. Strong understanding of cooking parameters, batch formulations, and quality control processes for protein meal and rendered fat. Proficiency in monitoring production KPIs and implementing corrective actions for process deviations. Knowledge of environmental regulations, hygiene standards, and HSE procedures. Experience in coordinating with maintenance teams and providing on-the-job training to operators. Work Location This full-time position is located in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

940043d8f6abe07a.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Director, Organizational Development to provide enterprise-wide leadership in organizational design, workforce planning, and OD foundations across the group and its subsidiaries. The Director ensures that organizational structures, roles, governance, and workforce capacity align with business priorities, capital programs, and long-term growth ambitions. Establish and govern organizational design frameworks, principles, and standards to ensure scalability and operational effectiveness. Oversee the design of organization structures, reporting lines, role charters, and governance forums. Lead the setup of OD foundations for new subsidiaries and group entities, including structure, grading architecture, and job frameworks. Own the enterprise workforce planning framework and annual/multi-year planning cycles in partnership with HRBPs and Finance. Govern enterprise job architecture, grading standards, and job evaluation methodologies, ensuring equity and internal consistency. Act as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and HR on organizational effectiveness and structural design. 9427d034cc22e34c.description: About the Role Ninja is seeking an experienced Invoice Matching Team Leader to join its warehouse-based operations team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves leading daily invoice matching, reconciliation, and exception resolution activities within a fast-paced warehouse environment. The team leader will also be responsible for coordinating team efforts and ensuring timely closure of transactions. Key Responsibilities Lead daily 3-way matching of supplier invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), Goods Received Notes (GRNs), returns, and supporting documents. Verify quantities, prices, item references, receiving status, and documentation before closing transactions. Investigate and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, quantities, receiving, returns, duplicates, and documentation. Coordinate with Receiving, Stock Control, Finance, Procurement/Commercial departments, and suppliers to resolve outstanding issues. Prioritize high-value, aged, and business-critical unmatched transactions, ensuring their timely closure. Allocate daily tasks and monitor team productivity, accuracy, workload, and completion rates. Review complex cases and provide coaching to team members on investigation and reconciliation procedures. Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation, and audit-ready reconciliations. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including matching completion, exception rate, ageing, accuracy, and closure time. Identify recurring issues and support initiatives for process improvement, standardization, and automation. Escalate material, unusual, or unsupported discrepancies to the relevant supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of relevant experience in invoice matching, reconciliation, Accounts Payable, inventory, warehouse administration, or supply chain operations. Previous team lead or supervisory experience is preferred. Strong knowledge of 3-way matching, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, returns, and invoice documentation. Good understanding of warehouse and inventory transaction flows and discrepancy investigation. Experience using ERP/WMS systems and advanced Excel for reconciliation and reporting. Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field. Certifications such as CPIM, inventory management, AP, or supply chain are considered an advantage. Required Skills Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail. Proficiency in documentation control. Excellent leadership and communication skills. Strong analytical, follow-up, and problem-solving abilities. Work Environment This role is based within a warehouse environment, requiring an individual who can thrive in a fast-paced operational setting and effectively manage a team to meet daily objectives. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position.

942da092aee12f49.description: About Tarabut Holding Limited Tarabut is a regulated open banking platform operating across the Middle East, licensed by SAMA in Saudi Arabia, the CBUAE in the UAE, and the CBB in Bahrain. The company facilitates connections between banks, lenders, and fintechs to financial data and payments infrastructure. Tarabut is also developing embedded finance distribution throughout the region, including an SME lending business in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview: Project Manager, Bank Programmes Tarabut is seeking a Project Manager to oversee its bank programmes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in Jeddah and reports directly to the Chief Strategy Officer. The Project Manager will be responsible for managing two to three key programmes concurrently, collaborating with tier-1 Saudi banks to expedite product launches. The position involves engaging with stakeholders from C-suite executives to integration managers, managing client relationships, and working with product and commercial teams to expand accounts. Regular travel to Riyadh and Bahrain is required. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain comprehensive programme plans, including milestones, dependencies, decisions, and risks. Serve as the primary point of contact for bank relationships. Organize and lead weekly meetings with bank counterparts, including working groups and steering committees, ensuring timely completion of actions. Address and resolve programme delays by engaging with detailed issues until progress is restored. Identify opportunities for programme expansion within existing engagements and translate them into defined follow-on projects. Manage approval-linked milestones and go-live gates in coordination with the compliance team. Proactively identify risks and propose viable solutions. Initial 90-Day Objectives Establish one programme plan and weekly cadence that is active and adopted by all counterparties. Successfully deliver the first inherited bank milestone on schedule. Implement a RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) log that is trusted by both internal and client teams. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 6 years of experience in project or programme management, with at least 4 years focused on delivery with banks or financial institutions in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated experience in managing senior client relationships and fostering account growth beyond administrative tasks. Proactive and hands-on approach, with the ability to delve into details and resolve stalled workstreams independently. Proven ability to influence and lead internal and client teams through effective cadence and results. Strong understanding of core systems, APIs, and integration delivery to accurately assess estimates and identify potential slippage. Must be based in Jeddah or willing to relocate. Preferred Skills and Experience Delivery experience with banks in other GCC countries. Domain expertise in open banking, lending, or payments. Established professional relationships within GCC banks. Proficiency with AI tooling and current knowledge of LLM capabilities, utilizing them to enhance programme efficiency while discerning when human oversight is necessary. Experience in guiding a regulated product through go-live with SAMA or CBB supervised institutions.

947d74ec9d41efd5.description: About the Role DHL is seeking a Site Supervisor to join their team in the Eastern Region. This full-time position involves coordinating warehouse and ground operations to ensure smooth movement, storage, and inventory control of materials, finished goods, tools, and packaging. The role focuses on meeting cost, quality, customer, and market-specific requirements in alignment with business strategy and corporate guidelines. Key Responsibilities Coordinate warehouse and manual handling plans and processes for safe and efficient operations at organization-owned or leased warehouses. Coach and guide the team to execute day-to-day tasks and activities, meeting work schedules and targets. Monitor operations activities to receive incoming shipments and process outgoing shipments within service performance timings. Participate in planning and scheduling inventory, and oversee ordering of products to meet organizational needs. Resolve conflicts and support coordination of delivery schedules with shippers and customers. Maintain up-to-date stock information, review daily material movement, and compare actual production schedules versus inventory levels. Ensure inventory accuracy of customer inventory by conducting daily/weekly inventory cycle counts. Perform inventory control, conduct stock turnover analyses, and manage material scheduling. Review inspection of incoming material for conformity with order specifications and identification of any defects. Execute safety/security and inventory control programs to ensure goods and equipment are safely operated, properly maintained, and stored. Review optimum utilization of warehouse facilities for storing and distributing material goods, including raw materials, finished products, tools, and packaging materials. Highlight issues and opportunities, and execute practices for warehouse and manual handling focusing on promoting efficiency, faster service, and lower costs. 94d82d7fc8478f1e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الدار البيضاء العالميه للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تنفيذ خطط الصيانة الدورية والطارئة للأبنية المختلفة، بما في ذلك إعداد قوائم المواد وتتبع سير العمل. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى دراسة خطط الصيانة، وتحديد المتطلبات اللازمة لتنفيذها، ومتابعة جميع أعمال الصيانة لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات، بالإضافة إلى قياس الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية المرتبطة بها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية للأبنية المختلفة، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المباني، مما يتطلب التعاون والتنسيق المستمر مع المهندسين وفرق العمل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

940d7888703dca28.description: Job Purpose: ​ ​ Ensure all company facilities within the area are maintained as per maintenance standards, by managing the team according to regional manager instruction and Co. standards and regulations . ​ Key Accountabilities : Maintenance Operations: Manage all preventive and corrective maintenance activities across assigned stores. Team & Contractor Management: Supervise technicians and contractors and monitor their performance against SLAs, KPIs, and contracts. Asset Reliability: Ensure critical equipment availability, investigate recurring failures, and coordinate RCA and corrective actions. CMMS Management: Monitor work orders, response times, closures, overdue tickets, and maintenance history. Emergency Management: Lead the response and escalation of critical breakdowns affecting store operations. Budget Control: Monitor maintenance costs, quotations, PRs/POs, and ensure activities remain within the approved budget. Compliance & Safety: Ensure maintenance activities comply with company standards, Civil Defense, HSE, and applicable regulations. Projects & Warranty: Support new stores, renovations, asset replacements, handovers, and warranty issues. Reporting & KPIs: Track maintenance performance, PPM compliance, uptime, repeat failures, costs, and contractor performance. Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Projects, HSE, QA, suppliers, and contractors. Overall responsibility: Ensure safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective maintenance of all assigned stores while achieving agreed KPIs, SLAs, and asset availability targets.

943a2df356167165.description: Job description Do you enjoy discovering new places, visiting different businesses, and sharing your honest opinion? Join ISC-CX as a **freelance Mystery Shopper** and get paid for evaluating real customer experiences. As a Mystery Shopper, you will visit stores, restaurants, car rental companies, and other businesses. You will follow a specific scenario, observe the customer service and overall experience, and complete a short questionnaire afterwards. What you will do * Visit businesses and evaluate the customer experience * Assess customer service, staff knowledge, cleanliness, and the overall service * Follow simple instructions and predefined scenarios * Take photos or provide other required information when requested * Complete questionnaires about your experience * Provide honest and objective feedback * Choose assignments that match your location and availability What we offer * **Freelance work with flexible assignments** * Choose projects according to your availability * Assignments in different industries and locations * Payment for completed and approved assignments * No previous Mystery Shopping experience required * Clear instructions and support for each project Skills Exceptional observational skills to accurately assess customer service and product offerings in various settings. Strong written communication skills in arabic and english, for creating detailed and insightful reports on shopping experiences Analytical thinking to identify trends and make recommendations based on customer interactions. Time management abilities to handle multiple assignments efficiently while meeting deadlines. Familiarity with digital tools and platforms used for reporting and data collection in market research. Interpersonal skills to engage effectively with clients and team members, fostering a collaborative work environment. Adaptability to thrive in diverse retail and service environments, adjusting approaches based on specific client needs.

94034c8ed24d5f15.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة برايت هوب عن أخصائي علاج وظيفي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تقييم وعلاج الأطفال الذين يواجهون صعوبات نمائية أو حسية أو حركية أو وظيفية. الهدف الرئيسي هو تعزيز استقلالية الأطفال وتحسين مهاراتهم اليومية لتتناسب مع أعمارهم واحتياجاتهم الفردية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم القدرات الحركية والحسية والإدراكية والوظيفية للأطفال باستخدام أدوات التقييم المناسبة. إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط العلاجية الفردية المصممة خصيصًا لتلبية احتياجات كل طفل. تقديم جلسات علاج وظيفي فردية أو جماعية للأطفال. تدريب الأطفال على مهارات الحياة اليومية لتعزيز استقلاليتهم. العمل على تطوير المهارات الحركية الدقيقة، والتآزر البصري الحركي، والتكامل الحسي. توعية وتدريب أولياء الأمور على البرامج المنزلية والخطط العلاجية لدعم استمرارية العلاج. توثيق الجلسات والتقارير العلاجية بشكل دوري ودقيق. التعاون الفعال مع أعضاء الفريق متعدد التخصصات لتحقيق أفضل النتائج العلاجية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المركز ومعايير الجودة والسلامة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات حاصل على ترخيص من الهيئة المختصة. جاهز للتوظيف الفوري. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص يسعى لتقديم أفضل رعاية للأطفال. يتطلب الدور العمل التعاوني مع فريق متعدد التخصصات لضمان تحقيق الأهداف العلاجية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

943d6863d9a88fa3.description: About Mastercard Services Mastercard Services provides capabilities that assist customers in growth, innovation, and decision-making. The global team develops and delivers end-to-end solutions for a diverse customer base, including financial institutions, retail and commerce, digital partners, and governments. These solutions encompass payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing solutions, Test & Learn experimentation, and data-driven insights and risk management services. The Marketing Solutions team focuses on converting marketing investment into measurable business growth by combining Mastercard's brand, partnerships, and marketing expertise with data-driven insights. The Role: Senior Managing Consultant, Services Business Development, Marketing Mastercard (KSA) is seeking a Senior Managing Consultant for Services Business Development in Marketing. This full-time, client-facing role in Riyadh involves partnering with senior marketing leaders at customer organizations to design and deliver high-impact marketing and customer engagement solutions across a multi-market portfolio in the region. The consultant will be accountable for revenue growth and will combine strong marketing expertise with the ability to originate, shape, and close opportunities. Key Responsibilities Achieve ambitious revenue targets for marketing solutions across a portfolio of markets. Build and deepen senior relationships with CMOs, Heads of Marketing, and broader business leadership at priority clients. Design integrated, outcome-led marketing and engagement solutions based on client business priorities. Develop compelling value-based narratives, proposals, and business cases. Collaborate with Product, Marketing & Communications, Account Management, and other internal teams to shape and deliver client propositions. Scope and manage engagements end-to-end, working with Legal, Compliance, and delivery partners to ensure high-quality execution. Demonstrate client impact and return on investment using evidence, benchmarks, and measurement. Share expertise with account teams to identify and advance opportunities. Represent Mastercard Services at client workshops, industry events, and market forums. Travel regularly across markets in the region. Required Experience and Qualifications Proven commercial track record in client development across marketing, partnerships, media, or experiential solutions, gained in an agency, media, partnership, or senior in-house marketing role. Alternatively, a high-performing senior marketing leader from a bank or major consumer brand with a demonstrable record of building high-impact campaigns and partnerships. Established senior marketing relationships in the region; financial services experience is an advantage. Demonstrated ability to structure and close deals involving multiple internal and external stakeholders. Experience managing agencies and third-party partners, including negotiating commercial terms and ensuring delivery. Track record of delivering against ambitious targets. Experience with P&L or margin management is an advantage. Distinguishing Attributes Understanding of how marketing investment decisions are made in large organizations, ideally within financial services. Experience in building and scaling a portfolio, practice, or partnership program. A strong network of senior marketing leaders and partners across the GCC and wider region. Creative flair for designing memorable customer experiences. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

94577435285bfc61.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير التسويق مسؤولية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والخطط التشغيلية المتعلقة بالتسويق، والإشراف المباشر على أنشطة إدارة وتخطيط أعمال التسويق لضمان توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف والسياسات والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية للتسويق، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم كفاءتها وفعاليتها. تطوير الخطط التسويقية السنوية، والخطط الإعلانية، والبرامج التسويقية والترويجية بالتنسيق مع الوحدات التنظيمية والجهات ذات العلاقة. الإشراف على تطبيق الخطط التسويقية والإعلامية، وضمان تنفيذها وفق الإجراءات والمواعيد والميزانيات المحددة، وتحقيقها للأهداف التسويقية. بناء علاقات استراتيجية مع الشركاء الخارجيين مثل شركات الإعلان، والتعاون معهم لإعداد ونشر المواد التسويقية والإعلانات الخاصة بالجهة ووحداتها. الإشراف على إعداد الدراسات التسويقية ومتابعة توزيع الكتيبات والمطبوعات والمواد التسويقية الأخرى المتعلقة بالجهة وخدماتها، وضمان نشرها وتوزيعها بما يخدم الأهداف التسويقية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على المساهمة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والخطط التشغيلية. مهارات إشرافية في إدارة وتخطيط أعمال التسويق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. تشجع شركة معين للموارد البشرية المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات على التقديم.

949c8050ad0ea2b1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية للتسويق أسواق المزرعة عن بائع مأكولات ومشروبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الهفوف. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تلبية احتياجات العملاء من المأكولات والمشروبات، وتقديم معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات والأسعار، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع المأكولات والمشروبات للزبائن بفعالية واحترافية. توفير معلومات شاملة ودقيقة للزبائن حول المأكولات والمشروبات المتوفرة وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام لضمان توفر المنتجات، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من الزبائن بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع المأكولات والمشروبات. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة نقاط البيع وإدارة المعاملات المالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات خدمة العملاء والتعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بفعالية. الدقة في التعامل مع المدفوعات والمعاملات المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والترتيب في المتجر. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الهفوف بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل التفاعل المباشر مع الزبائن والتعامل مع المنتجات الغذائية والمشروبات في بيئة بيع بالتجزئة. تقديم الطلبات نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذا الدور. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

94cf35e76ccf189a.description: About the Role AMAD Hospital is seeking a Clinical Psychologist Tamheer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is designed for professionals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on psychological evaluations, treatment planning, and patient care within a multidisciplinary hospital setting. Key Responsibilities Conduct psychological intake and initial evaluations for patients. Administer and accurately score standardized psychological and neuropsychological assessment tools. Contribute to the development, implementation, and ongoing review of individualized psychological treatment plans. Maintain precise clinical documentation, including progress notes and psychological reports, adhering to professional, ethical, and organizational standards. Collaborate effectively with the multidisciplinary healthcare team to ensure comprehensive patient care. Provide psychoeducation to patients and their caregivers, tailored to identified needs and established treatment goals. Ensure strict patient confidentiality and consistently adhere to all professional and ethical standards in practice. Experience Required Candidates for this position should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience in clinical psychology. This role is suitable for individuals beginning their professional journey in the field. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based at AMAD Hospital in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a collaborative healthcare environment focused on patient well-being. Application Information Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join our dedicated team.

94006f03883a204a.description: About BytePlus and the Role BytePlus, a business unit of ByteDance, focuses on providing leading technology solutions to global enterprise customers. This full-time role for a MEA Regional Partnership Manager is based in Riyadh and involves contributing to the BytePlus team by helping enterprise customers leverage ByteDance's intelligent technologies. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Build and manage a network of channel partners, resellers, and strategic alliances to enhance the adoption of AI image and video solutions. Identify, recruit, and enable new partners, including agencies, System Integrators (SIs), media firms, and cloud providers, to ensure their capability in selling BytePlus solutions. Lead co-selling initiatives with partners for enterprise and public-sector accounts, focusing on establishing new business relationships and driving partner-led revenue. Position ByteDance AI models as a scalable and cost-effective alternative to traditional video production, aiming to disrupt existing industry workflows. Oversee the end-to-end partner lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, enablement, and performance management. Develop joint go-to-market plans with cloud partners to generate and accelerate pipeline for public cloud customers. Collaborate with internal sales and pre-sales teams to co-sell and close partner-sourced opportunities. Track partner KPIs, MDF utilization, and contribution to revenue targets. Represent the company at partner events, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and executive engagements. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Working at ByteDance ByteDance's mission centers on inspiring creativity. The company's products are designed to facilitate authentic self-expression, discovery, and connection. Teams at ByteDance are global and diverse, working to create value for communities, inspire creativity, and enrich lives. The company fosters a culture of curiosity, humility, and impact within a rapidly growing technology environment, emphasizing continuous iteration and an "Always Day 1" mindset to achieve breakthroughs. Diversity and Inclusion ByteDance is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. The company's platform connects people globally, a principle reflected in its workplace environment. ByteDance aims to celebrate diverse voices and create an environment that mirrors the communities it serves, aligning with its mission to inspire creativity and enrich life.

940f143a35176d72.description: About Inovance Inovance Technology is a global provider of industrial automation products, technologies, and solutions. The company serves customers across manufacturing and process industries worldwide, with a portfolio that includes PLC, Servo, Inverter/VFD, HMI, Motion Control, and integrated automation solutions. Inovance aims to help industrial customers improve productivity, energy efficiency, equipment performance, and overall operational efficiency. With a growing international presence, Inovance is expanding its business across key global markets and strengthening local teams to better serve industrial end users and strategic customers. Role Overview Inovance is seeking an experienced Heavy Industry Sales Manager to drive business development and customer growth in key industrial sectors within Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses primarily on End Users and major industrial accounts, with an emphasis on building long-term customer relationships, identifying business opportunities, developing major projects, and driving sales growth. The position is entrepreneurial, requiring the ability to develop a market, build relationships, identify opportunities, and convert them into sustainable business. Key Responsibilities Develop an in-depth understanding of the regional market, including industry trends, economic environment, customer needs, competitive landscape, and business opportunities. Identify potential target industries, key accounts, projects, and business opportunities. Continuously develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential customers and projects. Develop and execute regional sales and business development strategies based on market opportunities and industry trends. Define target industries, key accounts, and strategic customers to support long-term growth and market expansion. Build and maintain strong relationships with industrial end users, plant owners, EPCs, and key decision-makers. Develop new customers and expand existing accounts, leading the sales process from opportunity identification to project execution and closing. Manage major projects and key opportunities to achieve sales and business objectives, developing a strong understanding of customer applications and business requirements. Develop and manage relationships with local agents, distributors, and System Integrators (SIs) where appropriate, building a local industrial automation ecosystem. Work closely with internal technical, presales, and product teams to deliver appropriate solutions to customers and strengthen Inovance's brand presence and industry reputation. Candidate Profile and Requirements The ideal candidate will be a business developer with strong industrial relationships and market resources, capable of integrating industry resources, customer relationships, technical understanding, and business development capabilities. This role requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Established customer networks and industry resources in sectors such as Oil & Gas, Metallurgy, Mining, Sugar, Paper, Cement, Petrochemical, Power & Energy, Heavy Machinery, or other Process Industries. Ability to open doors to major industrial end users and identify real business opportunities and projects. Strong understanding of customer requirements and effective communication skills with technical teams. Proven ability to build long-term relationships with key decision-makers. Capability to drive opportunities from initial contact to successful transaction. Experience in developing new markets and establishing a sustainable customer base. Application Candidates with a strong network within heavy and process industries who are interested in building the market with a growing global automation company are encouraged to apply.

941b0b75e111547b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين والحرفيين الآخرين أثناء تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية وتشخيص الأعطال المحتملة واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في مبادرات البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات كفني أجهزة إلكترونية أو في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. معرفة قوية بتركيب واختبار وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية ممتازة في التعامل مع المكونات والدوائر الإلكترونية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بكفاءة. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعاون مع المهندسين والفرق الفنية الأخرى. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الإلكترونية في هذا الدور ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في نجران، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع الفرق الهندسية والفنية لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

942830331dba474c.description: About the Role Amiantit is seeking a Senior Plant Sales Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 9464a44fc553d9b2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث أكاديمية الحصان العالمية عن معلم مرحلة متوسطة تربية فنية للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تدريس طلاب المرحلة المتوسطة في مجال التربية الفنية، وتطوير خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي لتعزيز تنمية الطلاب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس الطلاب في مجال التربية الفنية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتحديد الواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية. إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الصف لضمان بيئة تعليمية إيجابية ومنتجة. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، ووضع الدرجات لتقييم تقدم الطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة بذلك. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق الفعال مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريس التربية الفنية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع خطط الدروس وتصميم المواد التعليمية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتفاعل مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في أكاديمية الحصان العالمية بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق تعليمي ملتزم بدعم التنمية الأكاديمية والشخصية للطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

948779a578da35d4.description: About the Role Virtucruit is partnering with a leading organization in the energy and industrial services sector to appoint an Internal Controls & Compliance Manager. This full-time, senior, and business-critical role is within the Legal & Compliance function, based in Al Khobar. The position requires an experienced compliance professional to take ownership of a maturing compliance function, playing a foundational role in shaping governance, ethics, and risk management practices at the enterprise level. Role Purpose and Context The Internal Controls & Compliance Manager will be responsible for establishing and operationalizing the company's compliance program and internal control environment. This includes ensuring adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards. The role requires a hands-on, delivery-focused professional with 5-10 years of experience in building compliance programs and leading investigations, operating with a high degree of autonomy. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to senior management while driving execution across the business. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and implement the company's compliance and internal controls framework. Lead the compliance risk assessment process, including the development and maintenance of the compliance risk register. Develop, review, and implement compliance policies and procedures, covering areas such as Code of Conduct, Conflict of Interest, Data Privacy, Related Party Transactions, Gifts, Donations, Sponsorships & Charitable Contributions, Third-Party and Agent Compliance, and Trade and Business Conduct Compliance. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and recognized compliance standards. Oversee compliance controls across business operations, processes, and investments. Periodically assess the effectiveness of internal controls and recommend enhancements. Perform regular compliance reviews and assessments of company procedures and practices. Identify control gaps, emerging risks, and systemic issues, and drive remediation actions. Evaluate compliance systems and ensure appropriate tools and software are in place. Manage and oversee the company's helpline and whistleblowing program. Lead investigations into potential fraud, misconduct, abuse, or violations of company policies, in line with accepted investigation standards. Oversee compliance with the Code of Conduct and investigate any breaches. Maintain comprehensive documentation of complaints, investigations, findings, and outcomes. Liaise with external legal counsel on complex or sensitive compliance matters as required. Advise senior management and business stakeholders on compliance and internal controls matters. Design and deliver compliance training and awareness programs across the organization. Promote a strong culture of ethics, integrity, and accountability. Coordinate with Human Resources to ensure consistent disciplinary actions in cases of compliance breaches. Lead and supervise the compliance team, ensuring clear priorities and effective execution. Work closely with department heads to align compliance requirements with operational realities. Support company-wide initiatives relating to ethics, conflict of interest, and business conduct. Qualifications and Experience 7+ years of experience in compliance, internal controls, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in building and implementing compliance programs. Proven ability to lead investigations into potential misconduct or policy violations. Strong understanding of applicable laws, regulations, and compliance standards. Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and drive execution. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, within a leading organization in the energy and industrial services sector. The role involves working closely with senior management and various business stakeholders to embed a robust compliance and internal controls framework.

949509f35fed7ea6.description: About the Role Systems Arabia is seeking a Senior OpenShift & CP I Operations Engineer to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on the architecture, deployment, security, and management of Red Hat OpenShift and IBM CP4I platforms within hybrid cloud environments. The engineer will ensure high availability and continuous automated pipeline scaling for IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I) running on Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP). Key Responsibilities Plan, architect, install, and configure Red Hat OpenShift clusters across hybrid cloud environments. Provision the core IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I) platform using Operator Lifecycle Managers (OLM). Manage and lifecycle-configure core CP4I capabilities through IBM operators, including IBM MQ, API Connect, App Connect (ACE), Event Streams (Kafka), and Aspera. Secure cluster infrastructures by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), managing Red Hat OpenShift OAuth integrations, Keycloak/IAM identity layers, and SSL/TLS certificate configurations. Architect container persistent storage layers using Software-Defined Storage engines. Schedule seamless cluster upgrades, security patching, and node updates with a zero-downtime objective. Configure APM surveillance dashboards and automate multi-tenant provisioning using GitOps paradigms. Systematically troubleshoot complex cluster degradation events, persistent volume failures, and pod networking drops. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proven ability to coordinate systematic fixes and clear mitigation strategies under pressure, ensuring high-availability platforms remain operational. Demonstrated effectiveness in collaborating across remote and hybrid teams. Capability to translate complex container infrastructure into clear deployment guidance. A strong commitment to automation, infrastructure-as-code consistency, and platform compliance, while minimizing manual configuration practices. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring collaboration within a dynamic team focused on advanced cloud integration platforms. About Systems Arabia Systems Arabia is a technology company committed to delivering robust and scalable solutions. We focus on leveraging cutting-edge platforms to meet the evolving needs of our clients. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

949973c335e37532.description: About Bureau Veritas | Marine & Offshore Bureau Veritas is a global leader in Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) services. The company delivers high-quality services designed to assist clients in meeting the evolving challenges related to quality, safety, environmental protection, and social responsibility. The Role of NDT Tube Inspection Lead Bureau Veritas | Marine & Offshore is seeking an experienced NDT Tube Inspection Lead. This contract-based role involves overseeing and executing tube inspection activities during refinery, petrochemical, LNG, and industrial shutdown projects. The successful candidate will lead inspection teams, coordinate with clients, ensure adherence to project specifications, and deliver high-quality inspection services safely and efficiently. Key Responsibilities Lead and supervise tube inspection activities utilizing various NDT techniques. Plan, coordinate, and execute inspections of heat exchangers, boilers, condensers, fin-fan coolers, and pressure equipment. Perform and oversee IRIS (Internal Rotary Inspection System), RFET (Remote Field Eddy Current Testing), ECT (Eddy Current Testing), NFT (Near Field Testing), Visual Inspection (VT), Tube Mapping, and Data Analysis. Review inspection procedures, project specifications, and client requirements. Ensure proper calibration and functionality of all inspection equipment. Analyze inspection data and prepare comprehensive technical reports with recommendations. Coordinate daily activities with client representatives and site management. The contract is extendable based on project requirements.

944c11e91ac4691b.description: About the Role Catrion is seeking a Manager, Risk & Business Continuity to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves collaborating with department heads and the executive team to develop and implement strategies for anticipating, addressing, and mitigating the effects of various business interruptions. The Manager will also oversee the organization's enterprise risk management program, identifying and assessing risks that could impact the company's reputation, safety, security, or financial success. Key Responsibilities Conduct risk assessments by analyzing documentation, statistics, reports, market trends, and potential impacts from business disruptions. Establish and maintain enterprise risk management and business continuity policies, procedures, risk registers, mitigation plans, business impact analyses, and crisis response and recovery playbooks. Review risk management policies and protocols, recommending and implementing improvements. Validate risk mitigation plans and assess their effectiveness. Recommend and implement appropriate risk treatments, including insurance, safety and security measures, business continuity arrangements, and recovery measures. Collaborate with stakeholders to establish risk appetite and tolerance thresholds for risk-based decision-making. Provide risk management advice and assessment support across the organization. Prepare and present risk reports, recommendations, and proposals to executive leadership. Develop, maintain, review, and enhance business continuity and recovery plans and procedures. Maintain the organization's risk management system, whether manual or software-based. Conduct business impact analyses for departments and critical functions to identify dependencies, recovery priorities, and disruption impacts. Plan, coordinate, and oversee business continuity and crisis management exercises. Collaborate with IT to establish practices for protecting and restoring data and systems following disruptions. Define and implement recovery strategies to ensure operational continuity. Document exercise scenarios, objectives, results, lessons learned, and corrective actions. Develop and deliver training and awareness programs on enterprise risk management, business continuity, and disaster recovery. Coordinate with Quality, Health, Safety and Security functions and relevant authorities to align emergency management plans. Engage risk champions to maintain accurate and current risk registers. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual enterprise risk management reports. Monitor agreed risk and business continuity actions, escalate overdue items, and report implementation status. Promote risk ownership and process adherence across the organization. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in risk management and business continuity. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering operations in both Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

945c060e3e29a787.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الراشد أيه بيتونج عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل أماكن العمل، من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة أماكن العمل وحراسة الممتلكات بفعالية. القدرة على التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ والاستجابة للإنذارات. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الراشد أيه بيتونج. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الراشد أيه بيتونج.

94f3224c422b7f8d.description: Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla, and our next phase is expanding across the GCC and beyond. That expansion is not a copy-paste of what we built in Saudi Arabia. Each market has different payment rails, regulatory requirements, logistics realities, and merchant expectations. The product has to be adapted deliberately, not translated. This role owns that work, and it is the kind of seat that usually doesn't exist: The product decisions that make or break a market entry run through one person. You. You will make Salla work as well for a merchant anywhere in the GCC and beyond as it does in our home market: diagnosing where the product needs to change in each new market, deciding what gets built, adapted, or deferred, and driving the work from diagnosis to shipped improvement. You will drive impact across three major domains: Activation in New Markets (signup-to-first-order friction diagnosed and closed, with payments and know-your-customer compliance as the primary battleground) Market-Specific Product Fit (payments, logistics integrations, compliance workflows, and localization that make Salla feel native, not imported) Expansion Infrastructure (the shared product primitives and playbook that make the third market entry cheaper than the first) Responsibilities: Own the product roadmap for expansion across the GCC and beyond, one market at a time, with a clear line of sight to subsequent markets. Diagnose where and why merchants in each market drop off between signup and first order, and ship the product changes that close the gap. Drive the payment and compliance product work per market: know-your-customer flows, payment gateway integrations, regulatory requirements. Decide which parts of the core product need per-market adaptation and which stay shared infrastructure, and own where to invest. Define and monitor the metrics that reflect real market progress: time to first order, activation rate by market, ninety-day retention, share of merchants expanding regionally.
